title: Workflow Automation survey (questionnaire) templates: the mandatory Reason question, default families, toolbox question types and edit rules

prose.text: {{purpose}} {{notification-link}} The notification templates are in [[zwa.notifications]] and the mappings in [[zwa.notifications.template-mappings]].

prose.label: Defaults and status.
prose.text: {{default-families}} {{type-status}} {{one-per-language}} {{default-protections}} What admins can do with a system default survey template is stated two ways {{divergence:default-actions}}.

checks.do: Whether the survey template contains a drop-down panel type question named Reason.
Whether the survey template is published before expecting it to be used.

purpose.statement: A survey template sets the format of the survey a user or approver must complete when responding to an incident notification; its questions provide the justification for the incident.

quotes: A survey template provides the format for the survey that a user or approver must complete when responding to an incident notification from Workflow Automation. The survey includes questions that, when answered, provide the justification for the incident.

notification-link.statement: A notification template can include a link that opens the Incidents page and the survey the recipient must complete for the incident; the Template Mappings settings determine which notification and survey templates are used per source DLP type and notification type.

quotes: When an admin configures a notification template, they can choose to format a link in the notification template that enables the user or approver to view the incident details and the survey template where they can enter the response to the notification.
they can click that link, which opens the Incidents page and the survey that they must complete for the incident.

The template settings on the Template Mappings page determine the notification template and the survey templates that Workflow Automation uses for the different source Data Loss Prevention (DLP) types and notification types.

default-families.statement: The system default survey template families provided are End-user Justification - Questionnaire Template and Escalation - Questionnaire Template.

quotes: Workflow Automation provides the following system default survey template families and templates:
| End-user Justification - Questionnaire Template | End-user Justification - Questionnaire Template |
| Escalation - Questionnaire Template | Escalation - Questionnaire Template |

one-per-language.statement: For each survey template family only one template can be created in each language.

quotes: For each template family, you can create only one template in each language. You cannot create two templates of the same language for a single template family.

type-status.statement: The type of a survey template is always Questionnaire, and its status is Draft, Published or System Default.

quotes: The type of template is always Questionnaire.
Statuses are Draft, Published, and System Default.

reason-question.statement: A survey template must contain at least one drop-down panel type question named Reason; the survey creator starts with a placeholder drop-down question titled Reason, and Workflow Automation uses the SurveyJS Survey Creator component.

quotes: The survey template must contain at least one drop-down panel type question with the name of Reason.
contains a placeholder drop-down type question titled Reason.
Workflow Automation uses the Survey Creator component from SurveyJS.

presentation-only-types.statement: The Image Picker, HTML and Image question types in the survey toolbox are used for presentation only.

quotes: Image Picker: Adds an image or video to the template design. This type is used for presentation only.
HTML: Adds HTML to the template design. Use this type to format text as needed, include links, and insert media or other custom elements. This type is used for presentation only.
Image: Adds an image or video to the template design. This type is used for presentation only.

choice-types.statement: In the survey toolbox, Dropdown accepts only one answer while Multi-Select Dropdown accepts more than one, and Checkboxes accept multiple answers.

quotes: Dropdown: Adds a drop-down menu to the template design. Use this type for questions that can have multiple options but accept only one answer.
Multi-Select Dropdown: Adds a drop-down menu to the template design. Use this type for questions that can have multiple options but can accept more than one answer from the drop-down list.
Checkboxes: Adds checkboxes to the template design. Use this type for questions that accept multiple answers.

dynamic-types.statement: Respondents can add and remove panels in a Dynamic Panel question and rows in a Dynamic Matrix question.

quotes: Respondents can add and remove panels based on the template.
Dynamic Panel: Adds a dynamic panel that can contain multiple questions to the template design.
Dynamic Matrix: Adds a dynamic matrix to the template design. This type is similar to the Multi-Select Matrix, but respondents can add and remove matrix rows.

default-protections.statement: System default survey templates cannot be edited or deleted.

quotes: You cannot edit a system default template.
You cannot delete a system default template.

draft-button.statement: Save as Draft is not available when editing a published survey template, and Workflow Automation only uses published templates for its surveys.

quotes: Click Save as Draft. You can come back later and continue to work on the template design. This button is not available for published templates.
Workflow Automation only uses published templates for its surveys.

published-for-mappings.statement: The survey template page says template mappings can only be updated with templates in a published status.

quotes: You can only update the template mappings with templates that are in a published status.

default-actions.summary: The survey templates page says admins can only view and clone the system default survey templates, and elsewhere says a system default template can be translated.

quotes: Admins cannot edit the default survey templates. They can only view and clone the system default survey templates.

positions.says: Admins can only view and clone the default survey templates.

quotes: You can translate a published, system default, or draft template.
You can clone a published, system default, or draft template.

positions.says: A published, system default or draft template can be translated and cloned.

default-actions.impact: The page does not say whether translating a system default template is allowed in addition to viewing and cloning it.
